title: Diagonal recovery from noisy Fourier--Hermite coefficients: exact orders of the error
summary: We consider the recovery of functions of the weighted Wiener classes $W_s^μ$ from perturbed Fourier--Hermite coefficients in the metric of $L_\infty(\mathbb R)$. For the summation methods of the class $\mathcal S^θ$ we find error estimates on $W_s^μ$. The estimates take into account the behaviour of the Hermite functions both in the oscillatory region and near the turning point: the maxima of functions with different indices are attained at different points, and the supremum of a sum over a block of indices is substantially smaller than the sum of the suprema.
